name: I4. Claims adjudication by plan
rawText:
# Do you know which insurance plans receive the most claims, have the highest denial rates, and take the longest to process claims?
#  - Which insurance plans receive the highest number of claims?
#  - Which plans have the highest number of paid and denied claims?
#  - Which insurance plans have the highest claim denial percentages?
#  - How long does each insurance plan take, on average, to process claims?
#  - Which plans have the longest claim processing times?
#  - Which insurance plans pay out the most in total claims?
#  - Are plans with high claim volumes also experiencing higher denial rates?
#  - Which insurance plans combine high denial rates with long processing times?
#  - How does claim processing efficiency vary across different insurance tiers?
#  - Which insurance plans should we prioritize to reduce claim denials and processing delays?
# __________________________________________________

InsurancePlans: Name Plan,
    Tier,
    Policies.Sum(Claims.Count()) ClaimsReceived,
    Policies.Sum(Claims.CountIf(Status = <Paid>)) PaidClaims,
    Policies.Sum(Claims.CountIf(Status = <Denied>)) DeniedClaims,
    (DeniedClaims * 100.0 / NullIf(ClaimsReceived, 0)).Round(2) DenialPercent,
    (Policies.Sum(Claims.Sum(DateSub(ClaimDate, ProcessedDate))) * 1.0
        / NullIf(Policies.Sum(Claims.Count(ProcessedDate)), 0)).Round(1) AverageProcessingDays,
    Policies.Sum(Claims.Sum(PaidAmount)).Round(2) TotalPaid
  Where ClaimsReceived > 0
  Order ClaimsReceived DESC
  Take 10
